{{Quote|Captain Drayk and Sergeants Ven and Ando are coordinating what's left of our troops but I need to get back out there. It's going to take hours to clean up the mess Grievous has left behind here.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="Gambit" />}}
'''Drayk''' was a [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he was part of a [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] that was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] to [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|prevent]] a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] invasion&mdash;led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]&mdash;from eliminating the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]]. Although their communications were [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] due to a new [[Grievous's computer virus|Separatist weapon]], the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] forced Grievous to retreat from Kothlis. Following the battle, Drayk worked with [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeants]] [[Ando (clone trooper)|Ando]] and [[Ven (Battle of Kothlis)|Ven]] to coordinate the remaining [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces on Kothlis.

==Biography==
A [[Clone Captain/Legends|clone trooper captain]] known by the name of Drayk was one of many [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]<ref name="Gambit" /> who were bred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="Databank" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the second [[Standard year/Legends|year]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Gambit 314">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'' states that Skywalker left Tatooine eleven years before the events of the book. His departure from Tatooine is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', thus indicating that ''Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth'' is set in 21 BBY.</ref> the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] dispatched a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] to the planet [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] in order to thwart a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] planetary invasion led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who was intent on eliminating the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]]. Drayk was subsequently assigned to the [[Battle group/Legends|battle group]] bound for Kothlis. When the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic fleet]] arrived near Kothlis, Grievous made use of a [[Grievous's computer virus|computer virus]] that [[Jammer/Legends|jammed]] the communication systems of the Republic [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Although their mission was complicated because of the virus, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ordered a [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|counterattack]]. The Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] forces landed on Kothlis' surface and fought against the Confederacy's [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], suffering heavy losses due to the unexpectedly large number of [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Gambit" />

During the battle, the Republic fleet restored their communication systems and forced Grievous to withdraw from the [[Kothlis system/Legends|system]]. Skywalker subsequently led [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of Republic [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to support the ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on Kothlis, and the Republic forces eventually defeated the remaining battle droids. Because Kenobi had been injured during the battle and Skywalker was needed elsewhere, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Drayk received orders to conclude the work on Kothlis, since the Confederate attack had left heavy damages. [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeants]] [[Ven (Battle of Kothlis)|Ven]] and [[Ando (clone trooper)|Ando]] also remained on Kothlis to help coordinate the troops.<ref name="Gambit" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Drayk's a good officer.|Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Gambit" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Drayk<ref name="Gambit" /> was raised and trained on the planet Kamino. Like all clone troopers, he stood 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Databank" /> He fought for the Galactic Republic's Grand [[Army/Legends|Army]] and earned a reputation for being a good and reliable [[Officer/Legends|officer]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] General Anakin Skywalker possessed a level of trust for Drayk, and had the officer coordinate the remaining troops after the battle on Kothlis.<ref name="Gambit" />

==Behind the scenes==
Drayk first appeared in a tie-in novel for the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, ''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]'', which was written by [[Karen Miller]] and published in [[2010]].<ref name="Gambit" />
